name: Geosustara Enviro Services LLP
//tagline: Used in the Open Graph image alt and the header eyebrow. Kept descriptive rather than poetic because it is read by machines as often as by people.
//strapline: The brochure headline. Brand voice, not a description — never used where a description is required.
promise: Expertise you can trust. Engineering backed by evidence.
motto: Understand better. Decide smarter. Sustain responsibly.
//description: Meta description for the home page and the fallback for any page that does not set its own. Kept under 160 characters so it is not truncated in results.
description: Environmental and geospatial consultants in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala — EIA and Environmental Clearance support, GIS mapping, water and wastewater solutions.
//descriptionLong: Used only in structured data, where length is not penalised.
descriptionLong: Geosustara Enviro Services LLP is a sustainability-driven environmental consulting firm in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. We deliver Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and Environmental Clearance (EC) support, environmental compliance and auditing, GIS, remote sensing and thematic mapping, water quality analysis, wastewater and sewage treatment plant design, solid waste management, sustainability and ESG consulting, and academic research support across India.

contact.//phones: Both numbers are on the company brochure. The first is used wherever a single number is needed.

//map: Locality-level coordinates for Pappanamcode, shown at neighbourhood zoom. These are APPROXIMATE and are used only for the visual map — they are deliberately NOT published in the LocalBusiness structured data, where a wrong pin would do harm. Replace with your exact coordinates (right-click your building in Google Maps > copy the lat,lng) and raise the zoom to 16.
//areaServedNote: Kerala is named separately in the structured data. Most enquiries are state-level, and a LocalBusiness that claims only 'India' ranks poorly for the district terms people actually search.
//enquiry: Enquiry form wiring. Set `provider` and the matching credential, or override at build time with FORM_PROVIDER / FORM_ACCESS_KEY / FORM_ENDPOINT so nothing sensitive is committed. Until one is set the form falls back to phone, WhatsApp and email, all of which are always in the page. See README.md > Enquiry form.
//nav: An explicit Home item is included deliberately. The logo also links home, but this audience includes government bodies and residential communities where that convention is not universally known, and Indian institutional sites conventionally carry it.
//whyUs: Verbatim positioning from the company brochure. This is the firm's own framing of the problem it exists to solve, so it is used as written rather than paraphrased.

whyUs.problem: Environmental challenges are rarely simple. Limited site data, fragmented information, shifting regulatory requirements and solutions that look good on paper but cannot be built make environmental decision-making difficult.
whyUs.answer: We bridge that gap through field investigation, scientific analysis, GIS and remote sensing, and practical engineering — so what you receive is a clear picture of your site and a solution that can actually be implemented on it.

pillars.d: We start on the ground, not in a template. Site conditions are measured before anything is designed or claimed.
Water, waste and environmental data tested and interpreted against the standard that actually applies to its use.
Spatial evidence that answers where, adjacent to what, and draining into where — not just how much.
Treatment systems and technical designs sized for the real load, the real site and the real budget.

//expertise: The capability list from the brochure. These are the terms clients and search engines both use, so each one links to the service page that covers it.
//sectors: Flat list for the marquee. The same sectors carry a one-line description in `whoWeServe` for the pages that have room for it.

whoWeServe.d: Environmental assessments, statutory compliance and management solutions for operating plants and new projects.
Site assessment, mapping and environmental studies for quarrying and mineral-based operations.
Water, wastewater, swimming pool and environmental solutions for resorts, hotels and commercial buildings.
Environmental studies, thematic mapping and technical support for departments, boards and local self-government institutions.
Water quality, rainwater harvesting and waste management support for apartments, villas and gated communities.
Field capability, geospatial analysis and domain support for environmental research programmes.
Environmental analysis, GIS coaching, mapping and technical assistance for dissertations and academic projects.

//vision: Vision as stated on the company brochure.
vision: To be a premier catalyst for sustainable development, harmonizing industrial progress with environmental integrity.
mission: To deliver practical, cost-effective environmental and geospatial solutions through consulting, implementation, research support and capacity building — enabling sustainable development and informed decision-making.
//lifecycle: `short` is used on the home summary, `body` on /about/#approach. They are deliberately different wording so the two pages are not competing for the same text in search results.

lifecycle.title: Assessment
lifecycle.short: Find out where you actually stand, on the ground.
lifecycle.body: Site investigation, baseline studies and environmental audits establish the ground truth before anything is committed to paper.

lifecycle.title: Planning
lifecycle.short: Turn those findings into a defensible, costed plan.
lifecycle.body: Impact assessment, management plans, thematic mapping and GIS-based spatial modelling turn field findings into a defensible, costed strategy.

lifecycle.title: Implementation
lifecycle.short: Approvals obtained, systems commissioned, records kept.
lifecycle.body: Clearances and approvals secured, treatment and pollution control systems designed and commissioned, certification and reporting delivered on the ground.

lifecycle.title: Monitoring
lifecycle.short: We stay on, and keep the performance measurable.
lifecycle.body: Continuous environmental monitoring, operation and maintenance support, and measurable performance improvement over the long term.
